#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression analysis for KL vs WL."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# Load count data
count_df = pd.read_csv("inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {count_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(count_df.columns)}")

# --- Analysis 1: All replicates (KL1, KL2, KL3 vs WL1, WL2, WL3) ---
print("\n=== Analysis 1: All replicates (KL1-3 vs WL1-3) ===")

# Prepare metadata
samples_all = list(count_df.columns)
condition_all = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_all]
metadata_all = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition_all}, index=samples_all)
print(metadata_all)

# Create DESeqDataSet
dds_all = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=count_df,
    metadata=metadata_all,
    design="~condition",
)
# Filter low-count genes (optional but standard)
dds_all.deseq2()

# Statistical results: KL vs WL (WL is reference)
stat_res_all = DeseqStats(dds_all, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_res_all.summary()

res_all = stat_res_all.results_df
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(res_all)}")

# Shrunken LFC (apeglm)
stat_res_all.LFC_shrink()
res_shrunk_all = stat_res_all.results_df

# Apply criteria: p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10
sig_all = res_shrunk_all[
    (res_shrunk_all["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_shrunk_all["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_shrunk_all["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_all = len(sig_all)
print(f"Significant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig_all}")
print(f"  Up-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_all[sig_all['log2FoldChange'] > 0])}")
print(f"  Down-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_all[sig_all['log2FoldChange'] < 0])}")


# --- Analysis 2: Exclude third replicates (KL3, WL3) ---
print("\n=== Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates (KL3, WL3) ===")

# Filter out KL3 and WL3
exclude = ["KL3", "WL3"]
count_df_sub = count_df.drop(columns=exclude)
print(f"Subset count matrix: {count_df_sub.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(count_df_sub.columns)}")

samples_sub = list(count_df_sub.columns)
condition_sub = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_sub]
metadata_sub = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition_sub}, index=samples_sub)
print(metadata_sub)

dds_sub = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=count_df_sub,
    metadata=metadata_sub,
    design="~condition",
)
dds_sub.deseq2()

stat_res_sub = DeseqStats(dds_sub, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_res_sub.summary()

res_sub = stat_res_sub.results_df

# LFC shrinkage
stat_res_sub.LFC_shrink()
res_shrunk_sub = stat_res_sub.results_df

sig_sub = res_shrunk_sub[
    (res_shrunk_sub["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_shrunk_sub["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_shrunk_sub["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_sub = len(sig_sub)
print(f"Significant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig_sub}")
print(f"  Up-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_sub[sig_sub['log2FoldChange'] > 0])}")
print(f"  Down-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_sub[sig_sub['log2FoldChange'] < 0])}")


# --- Comparison ---
print("\n=== Comparison ===")
delta = n_sig_sub - n_sig_all
direction = "increase" if delta > 0 else ("decrease" if delta < 0 else "no change")
print(f"All replicates: {n_sig_all} significant DEGs")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression analysis for KL vs WL with pydeseq2."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import os

# Load count data (genes x samples)
count_df = pd.read_csv("inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {count_df.shape} (genes x samples)")
print(f"Columns: {list(count_df.columns)}")

# For pydeseq2: counts should be samples x genes, metadata rows = samples
# Transpose counts to samples x genes
counts_t = count_df.T
print(f"Transposed: {counts_t.shape} (samples x genes)")


def run_analysis(counts_t, label, coeff_name):
    """Run DESeq2 analysis and return number of significant DEGs."""
    samples = list(counts_t.index)
    condition = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples]
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition}, index=samples)
    print(f"\nMetadata:\n{metadata}")

    # Create DESeqDataSet: counts = samples x genes, metadata = sample info
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts_t,
        metadata=metadata,
        design="~condition",
    )
    dds.deseq2()

    # Statistical test: KL vs WL
    stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
    stat_res.summary()

    # LFC shrinkage with apeglm-style adaptive prior
    print(f"LFC columns: {stat_res.LFC.columns.tolist()}")
    stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff_name)

    res = stat_res.results_df
    print(f"Total genes tested: {len(res)}")

    # Criteria: p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10
    sig = res[
        (res["padj"] < 0.05) &
        (res["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
        (res["baseMean"] > 10)
    ]
    n_sig = len(sig)
    print(f"Significant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig}")
    print(f"  Up-regulated in KL: {len(sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] > 0])}")
    print(f"  Down-regulated in KL: {len(sig[sig['log2FoldChange'] < 0])}")

    return n_sig, res


# --- Analysis 1: All replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 1: All replicates (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)")
print("=" * 60)

# First, determine the LFC coefficient name with a quick run
samples_all = list(counts_t.index)
condition_all = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_all]
metadata_all = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition_all}, index=samples_all)
dds_all_tmp = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_t, metadata=metadata_all, design="~condition")
dds_all_tmp.deseq2()
stat_all_tmp = DeseqStats(dds_all_tmp, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_all_tmp.summary()
coeff_name = stat_all_tmp.LFC.columns[1]  # 2nd column is the condition effect
print(f"LFC coefficient name: {coeff_name}")

# Now with shrinkage
stat_all_tmp.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff_name)
res_all = stat_all_tmp.results_df

sig_all = res_all[
    (res_all["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_all["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_all["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_all = len(sig_all)
print(f"Significant DEGs: {n_sig_all}")
print(f"  Up-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_all[sig_all['log2FoldChange'] > 0])}")
print(f"  Down-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_all[sig_all['log2FoldChange'] < 0])}")


# --- Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 2: Excluding KL3 and WL3")
print("=" * 60)

exclude = ["KL3", "WL3"]
counts_t_sub = counts_t.drop(index=exclude)
print(f"Subset count matrix: {counts_t_sub.shape}")
print(f"Samples: {list(counts_t_sub.index)}")

samples_sub = list(counts_t_sub.index)
condition_sub = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_sub]
metadata_sub = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition_sub}, index=samples_sub)

dds_sub_tmp = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_t_sub, metadata=metadata_sub, design="~condition")
dds_sub_tmp.deseq2()
stat_sub_tmp = DeseqStats(dds_sub_tmp, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_sub_tmp.summary()
coeff_name_sub = stat_sub_tmp.LFC.columns[1]
print(f"LFC coefficient name: {coeff_name_sub}")

stat_sub_tmp.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff_name_sub)
res_sub = stat_sub_tmp.results_df

sig_sub = res_sub[
    (res_sub["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_sub["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_sub["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_sub = len(sig_sub)
print(f"Significant DEGs: {n_sig_sub}")
print(f"  Up-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_sub[sig_sub['log2FoldChange'] > 0])}")
print(f"  Down-regulated (KL vs WL): {len(sig_sub[sig_sub['log2FoldChange'] < 0])}")


# --- Comparison ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Comparison")
print("=" * 60)
delta = n_sig_sub - n_sig_all
direction = "increase" if delta > 0 else ("decrease" if delta < 0 else "no change")
print(f"All replicates: {n_sig_all} significant DEGs")
print(f"Without third replicates: {n_sig_sub} significant DEGs")
print(f"Change: {delta:+d} genes ({direction})")

# Write answer
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction)
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {direction}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression analysis for KL vs WL with pydeseq2.

Uses ref_level to set WL as reference so condition[T.KL] = log2(KL/WL),
allowing direct LFC shrinkage of the contrast of interest.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import os

# Load count data (genes x samples)
count_df = pd.read_csv("inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {count_df.shape} (genes x samples)")
print(f"Columns: {list(count_df.columns)}")

# For pydeseq2: counts should be samples x genes
counts_t = count_df.T


def run_analysis(counts_t, label):
    """Run DESeq2 and return number of significant DEGs (KL vs WL)."""
    samples = list(counts_t.index)
    condition = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples]
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition}, index=samples)
    print(f"\nMetadata:\n{metadata}")

    # Set WL as reference level so condition[T.KL] = log2(KL/WL)
    # This lets us shrink the KL effect directly
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts_t,
        metadata=metadata,
        design="~condition",
        ref_level=["condition", "WL"],
    )
    dds.deseq2()

    # Check design matrix
    print(f"Design matrix:\n{dds.obsm['design_matrix']}")

    # Statistical test: KL vs WL (WL is reference)
    stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
    stat_res.summary()

    # Verify LFC sign: log2FoldChange should be log2(KL/WL)
    print(f"LFC columns: {stat_res.LFC.columns.tolist()}")
    print(f"First few unshrunk LFCs:\n{stat_res.results_df[['baseMean', 'log2FoldChange']].head(5)}")

    # LFC shrinkage: shrink the KL coefficient (condition[T.KL])
    # This coefficient directly represents log2(KL/WL)
    coeff = "condition[T.KL]"
    print(f"Shrinking coefficient: {coeff}")
    stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff)

    res = stat_res.results_df
    print(f"First few shrunk LFCs:\n{res[['baseMean', 'log2FoldChange']].head(5)}")

    # Verify sign didn't flip
    assert res["log2FoldChange"].dropna().iloc[0] > 0, "LFC sign unexpected!"

    # Apply criteria: padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10
    sig = res[
        (res["padj"] < 0.05) &
        (res["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
        (res["baseMean"] > 10)
    ]
    n_sig = len(sig)
    n_up = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] > 0])
    n_down = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] < 0])
    print(f"Significant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig}")
    print(f"  Up-regulated in KL: {n_up}")
    print(f"  Down-regulated in KL: {n_down}")

    return n_sig, res


# --- Analysis 1: All replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 1: All replicates (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)")
print("=" * 60)

n_sig_all, res_all = run_analysis(counts_t, "all_replicates")

# --- Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 2: Excluding KL3 and WL3")
print("=" * 60)

exclude = ["KL3", "WL3"]
counts_t_sub = counts_t.drop(index=exclude)
print(f"Subset count matrix: {counts_t_sub.shape}")

n_sig_sub, res_sub = run_analysis(counts_t_sub, "no_third_replicates")

# --- Comparison ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Comparison")
print("=" * 60)
delta = n_sig_sub - n_sig_all
direction = "increase" if delta > 0 else ("decrease" if delta < 0 else "no change")
print(f"All replicates: {n_sig_all} significant DEGs")
print(f"Without third replicates: {n_sig_sub} significant DEGs")
print(f"Change: {delta:+d} genes ({direction})")

# Write answer
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction)
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {direction}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression analysis for KL vs WL with pydeseq2.

Runs two analyses:
1. All replicates (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)
2. Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2)

Criteria: padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10 with LFC shrinkage.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import os
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load count data (genes x samples)
count_df = pd.read_csv("inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {count_df.shape} (genes x samples)")

# For pydeseq2: counts should be samples x genes, metadata rows = samples
counts_t_all = count_df.T


def run_analysis(counts_t, label):
    """Run DESeq2: KL vs WL with LFC shrinkage. Returns number of sig DEGs."""
    samples = list(counts_t.index)
    condition = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples]
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition}, index=samples)
    print(f"\nSamples: {samples}")

    # DESeq2 analysis
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts_t,
        metadata=metadata,
        design="~condition",
    )
    dds.deseq2()

    # Wald test for KL vs WL (WL is the reference level)
    stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
    stat_res.summary()

    # In the design matrix, KL is reference (alphabetically first)
    # condition[T.WL] = log2(WL/KL), i.e., effect of being WL relative to KL
    # contrast log2FoldChange in results = log2(KL/WL) = -condition[T.WL]
    print(f"LFC columns: {stat_res.LFC.columns.tolist()}")
    print(f"Design levels: KL=reference, condition[T.WL]=log(WL/KL)")

    # Shrink the WL coefficient (condition[T.WL]), then flip sign
    # to get shrunk KL vs WL fold change
    stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition[T.WL]")

    # After lfc_shrink, results_df["log2FoldChange"] is condition[T.WL]/log(2)
    # = log2(WL/KL). Flip sign to get log2(KL/WL).
    res = stat_res.results_df.copy()
    res["log2FoldChange"] = -res["log2FoldChange"]

    # Verify: check a high-count gene for sanity
    sample_gene = res.loc["ENSMUSG00000000001"]
    print(f"ENSG00000000001 shrunk LFC (KL vs WL): {sample_gene['log2FoldChange']:.4f}")

    # Apply criteria
    sig = res[
        (res["padj"] < 0.05) &
        (res["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
        (res["baseMean"] > 10)
    ]
    n_sig = len(sig)
    n_up = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] > 0])
    n_down = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] < 0])
    print(f"Significant DEGs (padj<0.05, |LFC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig}")
    print(f"  Up in KL: {n_up}, Down in KL: {n_down}")

    return n_sig, res


# --- Analysis 1: All replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 1: All replicates (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)")
print("=" * 60)
n_sig_all, res_all = run_analysis(counts_t_all, "all_replicates")

# --- Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Analysis 2: Excluding KL3 and WL3")
print("=" * 60)

exclude = ["KL3", "WL3"]
counts_t_sub = counts_t_all.drop(index=exclude)
print(f"Subset count matrix: {counts_t_sub.shape}")

n_sig_sub, res_sub = run_analysis(counts_t_sub, "no_third_replicates")

# --- Comparison ---
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Comparison")
print("=" * 60)
delta = n_sig_sub - n_sig_all
direction = "increase" if delta > 0 else ("decrease" if delta < 0 else "no change")
print(f"All replicates: {n_sig_all} significant DEGs")
print(f"Without third replicates: {n_sig_sub} significant DEGs")
print(f"Change: {delta:+d} genes ({direction})")

# Write answer
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction)
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {direction}")
